i.norm: Tests the deprecated {@link NullInputStream#INSTANCE} singleton field. The singleton exists for backward compatibility but is not recommended for reuse without calling {@link NullInputStream#init()} to reset state.
Verifies that {@link NullInputStream#INSTANCE} has been initialized and is accessible. Despite being deprecated, the field must remain non-null as part of the public API contract.
